findings.description: The Lambda environment variables embed an AWS access key ID and secret access key in the Terraform configuration. They can be exposed through source control, Terraform state/configuration access, or access to the Lambda function configuration.
The function is configured with the end-of-life Node.js 12.x runtime, which no longer receives security updates and can expose the function to known runtime vulnerabilities.
